LABEL: HTO editors
A IAO:0000115: Definition source denoting a term authored by the HTO editors for this release rather than taken from a cited publication.

LABEL: tasting event
A IAO:0000115: A planned process in which a human taster orally samples a stimulus and reports one or more perceived taste qualities.

LABEL: taster role
A IAO:0000115: A role borne by a person in virtue of taking part in a tasting event as the person doing the tasting.

LABEL: taste stimulus
A IAO:0000115: A material entity presented to a taster to be tasted.

LABEL: reference tastant
A IAO:0000115: A taste stimulus consisting of a single chemical compound presented at a stated concentration in order to calibrate or classify a taster.

LABEL: taste percept assertion
A IAO:0000115: An information content entity recording that one taster perceived one perceptual taste quality in one stimulus on one occasion.

LABEL: intensity rating
A IAO:0000115: A scalar measurement datum recording how strong a perceived taste quality was, on a stated scale.

LABEL: hedonic rating
A IAO:0000115: A scalar measurement datum recording how much a taster liked or disliked a stimulus, on a stated scale.

LABEL: rating scale
A IAO:0000115: An information content entity specifying the permitted values and anchors used to record a rating.

LABEL: detection threshold datum
A IAO:0000115: A scalar measurement datum recording the lowest concentration of a tastant at which a taster reliably detects that something differs from the blank.

LABEL: recognition threshold datum
A IAO:0000115: A scalar measurement datum recording the lowest concentration of a tastant at which a taster reliably names the quality correctly.

LABEL: taster status
A IAO:0000115: An organism trait classifying a person by their sensitivity to a reference bitter tastant, conventionally propylthiouracil.

LABEL: PROP non-taster
A IAO:0000115: A taster status in which the person reports no bitterness from a propylthiouracil test strip.

LABEL: PROP medium taster
A IAO:0000115: A taster status in which the person reports moderate bitterness from a propylthiouracil test strip.

LABEL: PROP super-taster
A IAO:0000115: A taster status in which the person reports intense bitterness from a propylthiouracil test strip.

LABEL: TAS2R38 diplotype
A IAO:0000115: An information content entity recording the pair of TAS2R38 haplotypes carried by a person, each haplotype being the combination of the amino acid states at positions 49, 262 and 296.

LABEL: taste genotype assertion
A IAO:0000115: An information content entity recording an assertion about a person's genotype at a locus relevant to taste perception.

LABEL: tasting session
A IAO:0000115: A planned process comprising the tasting events performed by one or more tasters on one occasion under one protocol.

LABEL: palate cleansing process
A IAO:0000115: A process performed between tasting events in order to reduce carry-over of taste from the previous stimulus.

LABEL: blinding condition
A IAO:0000115: An information content entity stating what the taster was able to know about the identity of the stimulus at the time of tasting.

LABEL: time-intensity profile datum
A IAO:0000115: A scalar measurement datum recording perceived intensity as a function of time since the stimulus entered the mouth.

LABEL: taste confounder
A IAO:0000115: An information content entity recording a property of a taster that is known to alter taste perception and that should be accounted for when analysing their ratings.

LABEL: tobacco use confounder
A IAO:0000115: A taste confounder recording that the taster currently uses tobacco.

LABEL: recent upper respiratory infection confounder
A IAO:0000115: A taste confounder recording that the taster recently had an upper respiratory infection, including a recent loss of smell.

LABEL: xerostomia confounder
A IAO:0000115: A taste confounder recording that the taster has reduced salivary flow.

LABEL: dysgeusia-associated medication confounder
A IAO:0000115: A taste confounder recording that the taster takes a medication with a documented taste-distortion side effect.

LABEL: rating
A IAO:0000115: A scalar measurement datum recording a value a taster reported on a stated scale, whether of a perceived quality's intensity or of liking.
